blocks.name: Require a distinct verified similarity
blocks.documentation:
Estimate an orientation-preserving moving-to-reference similarity using Fourier magnitude, semilog polar remapping and phase proposals, then translation and spatial verification. Both 180-degree alternatives and additional polar peaks are evaluated. Optional affine ECC is projected to isotropic scale/rotation before verification. Distinct near-equal verified poses withhold primary geometry and aligned images.

Selections affect reference-grid verification. The Fourier seed sees the whole image; use upstream cropping/masking for unrelated clutter. Candidate uniqueness is conditional on the searched ranges and finite proposal budget. This is whole-image registration. It does not perform multi-part matching. Outputs keep moving depth/encoding and use the reference frame. The moving ticket and both source grids remain explicit. Scores are correlations, not probabilities.

blocks.name: Original similarity fixtures — MIT
blocks.description: Original 16-bit RGB part, projects and generator under the repository's MIT license. Sine/cosine geometry defines a 145-degree, 0.93-scale forward warp with offset [-3,6]. Registration recovers its inverse and verifies the 180-degree spectral alternative spatially. The symmetric project fails and withholds its transform; a [-45,45] orientation prior resolves that fixture. Pixel scores are not probabilities or occlusion measurements. OpenCV references: https://docs.opencv.org/5.0/main_modules/imgproc_transform.html and https://docs.opencv.org/5.0/main_modules/imgproc_motion.html
